description: What a page-speed metric or term means, its good / needs-improvement / poor thresholds, and how real sites score on it: the median and the share of sites within the "good" line across the WebSpeed audit base (mobile lab runs of thousands of original sites), with the sample size and snapshot date. Also how many sites apply a technique such as fetchpriority, lazy loading or font-display. Use when the user asks whether a value is good or bad ("is an LCP of 4 s bad?"), what LCP / CLS / TBT / INP / TTFB / Speed Index / PageSpeed score means, or how other sites compare.

metric.description: Metric or term, e.g. LCP, Largest Contentful Paint, CLS, TBT, INP, TTFB, Speed Index, PageSpeed score, fetchpriority, font-display

name: explain_metric
title: Explain a speed metric with WebSpeed base numbers
